rows.description: Grappling deeply with the realities of mortality, life's inherent meaning, and long-term purpose.
Feeling a deep, resonant sense of purpose tied to long-term goals or community impact.
Understanding others' complex emotional states without necessarily taking them on.
Consciously processing and letting go of deep resentment toward oneself or others.
Extending unearned goodwill and understanding to others despite recognizing their flaws.
Consistently upholding high moral standards across personal, professional, and societal leadership.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: Putting professional standing or career capital on the line to defend organizational ethics and prevent institutional corruption.
Managing long-term investments, capital growth, insurance planning, and economic stability for future family/dependents.
Structuring long-term career, family, and social choices around sustained societal contribution.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: Integrating systemic impacts, ethical principles, and risk management into high-stakes decisions.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22
